---
title: "Teaching"
---

I aim to help students see economics as a way to understand and think critically about society. I hope to encourage them to develop intellectually and build confidence in their abilities and ambitions. I am also committed to equal opportunities and widening participation, from my early work as a volunteer maths tutor to Oxford’s UNIQ programme and the Manchester Access Programme.

## Teaching qualification

**Fellow of Advance HE (FHEA)**, since 2026

**University of Oxford** — Graduate Teaching Assistant, January and October 2021
